questions.prompt: Which disaster struck the passenger liner Titanic in 1912?
questions.fact: The wreck was not located until 1985, and the search was partly cover for a classified mission to find two sunken submarines.

questions.prompt: Which scientist is credited with the discovery of the electron?
questions.fact: He proposed atoms were a soup of electrons in positive charge, a model his own student later demolished.

questions.prompt: How many players are on a baseball team's fielding side?
questions.fact: The pitcher and catcher are together called the battery, a term borrowed from artillery.

questions.prompt: Which streaming platform produced the series Squid Game?
questions.fact: Its writer spent a decade failing to sell the script, at one point selling his laptop to cover living costs.

questions.prompt: Which European country has the most active volcano in the region?
questions.fact: Mount Etna has erupted almost continuously for thousands of years, and towns on its slopes simply rebuild around the lava.

questions.prompt: Which novel features a whale called the White Whale?
questions.fact: It was inspired partly by a real whale that reportedly attacked ships off Chile and survived dozens of harpoons.

questions.prompt: What is the term for a duplicate copy of data kept for safety?
questions.fact: The standard advice is three copies on two kinds of media with one kept off site, usually shortened to three-two-one.
